title: Big and Small
text: Milo has two dogs, Rex and Pip. Rex is huge. He has to bend down to fit through the door. Pip is tiny. She walks right under the table and never has to bend at all. When Milo tosses the ball, Rex runs fast and grabs it first. Pip is quick too, and she zips right behind him, catching up just as he turns around. At night, Rex curls up on his big bed, and Pip curls up on her tiny bed. Milo tucks them both in, and the house grows quiet and still.
comprehension_hint_topics: how you can tell Rex is bigger than Pip
how you can tell Pip is just as quick as Rex
